pooled_unit: biological subject; mean fold effects within subject before resampling
gate_A: selected absolute alpha gap >=0.25 in at least four of five folds
gate_B: outer differential minus best-uniform BA >=0.005 in at least four of five folds and pooled paired 95% CI lower bound >0
gate_C: outer differential minus norm-matched-uniform BA >0 in at least four folds and pooled paired 95% CI lower bound >-0.005
gate_D_random: outer Protected differential BA exceeds 95th percentile of 100 separately TRAIN-selected rank-matched random partitions in at least four folds
gate_D_PCA: outer Protected differential BA exceeds PCA differential in at least three folds or pooled paired 95% CI lower bound >0
gate_D_supervised: honest comparison, no Protected-specific conclusion when supervised-decision differential pooled BA is at least Protected BA without a positive Protected-minus-supervised paired 95% CI
gate_E_replication: at least one replication cell has positive differential-minus-best-uniform BA in at least three folds and positive pooled subject-equal mean
oracle_nontransfer_label: evaluation-only per-subject best-grid versus per-subject best-diagonal BA headroom >=0.005 in a majority of outer subjects, while global TRAIN-selected primary differential fails gate B
uniform_explains_label: primary differential beats full-generic BA but fails best-uniform or norm-matched contrast
interpretation_priority: PERSISTENCE_GUIDED_DIFFERENTIAL_ADAPTATION_SUPPORTED when A-E all pass and Protected competitive with supervised control
DIFFERENTIAL_ADAPTATION_SUPPORTED_BUT_NOT_PERSIST_SPECIFIC when A/B/C/E pass but PCA or supervised decision is as good or better
OFF_DIAGONAL_ORACLE_EXISTS_BUT_DOES_NOT_TRANSFER when evaluation-only oracle headroom exists but B fails
UNIFORM_SHRINKAGE_EXPLAINS_THE_GAIN when the differential beats full generic but B or C fails
